heartbeat: 0 jobs processed in last 5 minutes, queue depth 640

expected.note: Last deploy was six days ago and ran healthily until 03:12. Never read by the agents.
expected.root_cause: Thread worker-7 is holding the job_registry lock and never released it; all 16 worker threads are blocked, so throughput is zero while the process stays alive. Not caused by a deploy, memory or CPU.
expected.why: Restarting clears the wedged in-process lock. A rollback would redeploy the same six-day-old version that ran fine for days.
